implementation_strategy: Execute paired confirmatory runs using hosted gpt-5-mini API for generation/repair and Dockerized Kathará/Mininet emulator containers for semantic ground-truth validation. All generation, verification, repair, transformation, and scoring are automated: (1) deterministic prompts and fixed seeds; (2) one initial generation per task per arm; (3) guarded arm invokes verifier oracle and at most one automated repair call when verifier rejects; (4) deterministic scorer compares verifier outcome and emulator ground truth for validation subset; (5) all artifacts, hashes, and logs archived. No human labour or external/private resources used.
public_resources: SyntheticNetOpsIntentConfig_v1 (public dataset produced with this study)
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini @ openai_responses (single hosted model; model_version = gpt-5-mini)
task_manifest_strategy: Construct 270 tasks deterministically: 3 vendor-style syntaxes × 3 topology templates = 9 clusters × 30 tasks each. Tasks are generated from the public SyntheticNetOpsIntentConfig_v1 generator with fixed RNG seed. Deterministic SHA-256 hashing of each prompt/intent stored at creation to detect duplicates/contamination.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Apply syntax_normalization (vendor CLI canonicalizer), token-level vendor-to-canonical mapping, and comment/whitespace normalization. Transformation units are Dockerized and unit-tested; any transformation that causes emulator semantic divergence on the validation test-suite is automatically rejected and versioned.
execution_batches: 10 batches of 27 tasks each; per-batch worst-case model calls = 27 tasks × 2 calls = 54 calls; total worst-case calls = 10 × 54 = 540
randomisation_plan: Paired within-task design; batch assignment and within-batch execution order randomized with a fixed cryptographic RNG seed (seed=2026-08-26-PREREGISTER). Randomization deterministic and recorded; pairing preserved (both conditions per task).
caching_plan: Deterministic caching of identical prompt+context signatures (SHA-256) to avoid redundant API calls; response cache read-only during confirmatory run to preserve experimental determinism. RAG index frozen; no external retrieval allowed.
failure_recovery_plan: Per-adapter enforced limits: maximum_attempts_per_call = 1. No automated additional retries beyond the adapter limit. Any API/provider transient failure that prevents obtaining a model response for a call is logged; the pair is handled per preregistered analysis 'complete_pair_primary' (pair remains; analysis executor applies primary treatment). All failures recorded with error type and hashes. No human intervention.
result_schema: Standard paired_binary_episode_v1: per-episode record includes study_id, task_id, condition, model_prompt_hash, model_response, verifier_result, emulator_result (when executed), transformation_versions, timestamps, and artifact hashes. The resolver will produce aggregated estimand inputs for paired_binary_analysis_v1.
estimated_compute_notes: Total planned hosted-model calls = 540 (2 per task worst-case). Dockerized emulator runs scheduled across CPU nodes; CPU-only emulation and deterministic scheduling expected to complete within the 7-day wall-clock limit. No local GPU usage. Hosted API usage confined to a single hosted model (gpt-5-mini) within the capability manifest call budget. Storage needed for transcripts and hashes ≈ 5–10 GB; CPU nodes (4 cores × 2 nodes) suffice for Dockerized Kathará emulation and validators.
